title: Nazi submarine traffic intercepted near Patagonia

tellings.quote: intercepted Nazi submarine traffic going uh to Argentina right around Patagonia.

plain: Around 1946, Nazi submarine traffic heading to Argentina, near Patagonia, was intercepted. A researcher named Jason Jorjani says so on the show, without naming a source or saying who did the intercepting. He raises it while talking about a hidden Nazi program, which it would suggest carried on in South America after the war.
